t: The $(item)Air Cannon/$ is a device you can use to transport items quite some distance, through the air. It uses $(l:base_concepts/pressure)compressed air/$ as propellant.$(p)You will also need a $(l:tools/gps_tool)GPS Tool/$ to aim the $(item)Air Cannon/$ (although the GPS Tool can be removed and re-used once the Cannon is aimed).$(p)A $(#f00)redstone pulse/$ will trigger the Cannon to fire.
$(item)空气炮/$是一种可用于通过空气将物品运输到相当远距离的装置。它使用$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压缩空气/$作为推进剂。$(p)你还需要一个$(l:tools/gps_tool)定位工具/$来瞄准$(item)空气炮/$（不过一旦大炮瞄准完成，定位工具就可以取下并重复使用）。$(p)一个$(#f00)红石脉冲/$会触发大炮开火。

With a $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)Dispenser Upgrade/$ installed, the $(item)Air Cannon/$ behaves like a vanilla $(item)Dispenser/$ for certain items, e.g. TNT or Fire Charges.$(p)With an $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#entity_tracker)Entity Tracker Upgrade/$, the $(item)Air Cannon/$ will not launch items from its inventory, but instead launch the nearest entity (including you!) when triggered.

安装$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)发射器升级/$后，$(item)空气炮/$对某些物品的行为会像原版的$(item)发射器/$一样，例如 TNT 或火焰弹。$(p)安装$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#entity_tracker)实体追踪升级/$后，$(item)空气炮/$被触发时将不会从其容器中发射物品，而是会发射最近的实体（包括你自己！）。
